coordinated_activities.activity: Sleeping in on the public holiday, catching up on rest after recent rotating and night shifts, fan on low and light off
Waking up slowly, washing face and brushing teeth, taking medication and running through the day's reminder checklist
Making and eating a slow flexitarian breakfast of toast with eggs and vegetables, brewing a pot of tea and checking written notes about bills and the weekly budget
Loading and running the washing machine with his aged-care work uniforms and personal laundry, then hanging items to dry
Doing household chores: wiping down the benches, sorting the refrigerator and freezer, and putting shared kitchen items back in labelled places
Studying at his desk with the lamp on, reading assigned social work readings and typing written notes on his computer
Preparing and eating a simple vegetarian lunch, reheating rice in the rice cooker and drinking tea
Taking a slow walk around the neighbourhood park, getting fresh air and light exercise on his day off
Volunteering an afternoon shift at the animal shelter, feeding and socialising the animals and helping with cleaning tasks
Travelling home by train and bus from the shelter (public transport, no electric vehicle needed)
Showering and changing into comfortable home clothes after volunteering
Cooking and eating a flexitarian dinner of stir-fried vegetables, tofu and rice, then washing up his own dishes
Studying at his desk, reviewing placement notes and updating his written weekly planner and reminders on his computer
Making a cup of herbal tea and checking his cash budget for the coming week
Quiet leisure time in his room, looking at the photo of his family dog in China and reading a book
Night-time routine: washing up, brushing teeth and setting out clothes and reminders for the next day
Sleeping, with the fan on low for background noise and the light off
